answer: A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ember counter is kept in prism and echo publishes each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4026 identities would post 4730 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
